title: Tap to fly side scroller
when: The user wants a one button game where each tap lifts a flying character through gaps in moving obstacles, scoring per gap.
prompt:
Goal: Snappy, frame rate independent physics with fair gaps and instant restarts.
Steps:
1. logic.mjs with dt: vy += gravity x dt, a tap sets vy to the flap velocity; gate pairs move left at constant speed with a random gap center inside safe bounds.
2. Collision of a circle against gate rectangles, floor and ceiling; plus 1 when the player passes a gate center, once.
3. Input: pointerdown on the canvas, Space or ArrowUp; first input starts; ignore key repeat.
4. Spawn gates every 1.5 s from an object pool.
5. Parallax layers and screen shake only when matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") is false.
6. Score and best in localStorage guarded; game over panel with the score in aria-live and a Restart button that takes focus.
7. test.mjs: gravity, flap, gap bounds, single score per gate, collision edges.
Quality bar:
- Hitbox slightly smaller than the sprite.
- Restart is one tap.
- Same feel at 60 and 120 Hz.
Pitfalls:
- Gaps that are impossible to reach.
- Score counted every frame inside the gate.
- Tap also scrolling or zooming the page.
Verify:
- [ ] Physics tested.
- [ ] Score live.
- [ ] Reduced motion respected.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, game.js, logic.mjs (physics and scoring), test.mjs.

examples.input: um jogo de tocar para voar entre canos
examples.output: tap or Space to flap, gates every 1.5 s, best score saved
